stories.title: ASSISTA: pós-debate entre candidatos ao Senado pelo RS

en.title: WATCH: Post-debate between candidates for Senate in RS
en.summary: RBS TV hosted a debate among eight Senate candidates from Rio Grande do Sul on Friday night, featuring participants from PSD, PSOL, Novo, PSDB, PT, Cidadania, MDB, and PL parties, with journalist Elói Zorzetto moderating.

stories.title: Joesley ‘desaforado’, reforma tributária, terras raras: as falas de Lula em jantar com empresários

en.title: Joesley 'unafraid,' tax reform, rare earths: Lula's statements at dinner with businesspeople
en.summary: President Lula made remarks about various economic and political topics during a dinner event with businesspeople, including comments on tax reform and rare earth minerals.

stories.title: A empresários Lula diz que estabilidade fiscal é obrigatória e defende reforma do Judiciário

en.title: Lula tells businesspeople that fiscal stability is mandatory and defends Judiciary reform
en.summary: President Lula addressed nearly 700 businesspeople in São Paulo, emphasizing the importance of fiscal stability and proposing Judiciary reform while criticizing regulatory agencies and a bank owner.

stories.title: Campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro vê estrago com notícia falsa sobre Nossa Senhora e tenta conter danos

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign sees damage from false news about Nossa Senhora and attempts to contain it
en.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign moved to counter misinformation circulating on social media falsely claiming he intended to remove Nossa Senhora Aparecida's status as Brazil's patron saint.

stories.title: Trump rejeita plano iraniano de cessar-fogo e quer retomar bombardeios em novembro, diz jornal

en.title: Trump rejects Iranian ceasefire plan and wants to resume bombardments in November, says newspaper
en.summary: According to reporting, Trump has rejected an Iranian ceasefire proposal and intends to resume bombing operations in November.

stories.title: Confira como foi a sexta-feira (25) dos presidenciáveis

en.title: Check how it was Friday (25) for the presidential candidates
en.summary: Presidential candidates conducted campaign activities on Friday including canvassing, rallies, leafleting, and meetings with supporters, along with debates and other scheduled events.

stories.title: Resultado da Quina 7127: confira as dezenas sorteadas nesta sexta-feira (25)

en.title: Quina 7127 results: check the numbers drawn this Friday (25)
en.summary: The Quina lottery draw 7127 occurred on Friday with an estimated prize of 9 million reais, with the drawn numbers available for verification.

stories.title: Resultado da Lotofácil 3789: confira as dezenas sorteadas nesta sexta-feira (25)

en.title: Lotofácil 3789 results: check the numbers drawn this Friday (25)
en.summary: The Lotofácil lottery draw 3789 was held on Friday by Caixa Econômica Federal in São Paulo with an estimated prize of 9 million reais.

stories.title: Alegações infundadas sobre projeto para ‘rebaixar’ Nossa Senhora Aparecida mobilizam as redes

en.title: Unfounded allegations about project to 'demote' Nossa Senhora Aparecida mobilize social networks
en.summary: Unsubstantiated claims regarding a project concerning Nossa Senhora Aparecida have generated significant activity on social media platforms.

stories.title: Inmet emite alerta de grande perigo por onda de calor no fim de semana

en.title: Inmet issues red alert for dangerous heat wave over the weekend
en.summary: Brazil's meteorological institute issued a red alert for an extreme heat wave expected from Saturday through Wednesday, with eight states potentially reaching temperatures above 40 degrees Celsius.

stories.title: Donald Trump deve rejeitar plano do Irã para cessar-fogo, diz jornal

en.title: Donald Trump expected to reject Iran's ceasefire plan, according to newspaper
en.summary: A report indicates that U.S. President Donald Trump is expected to reject a ceasefire proposal submitted by Iran to end the conflict between the two countries.

stories.title: Inmet emite alerta vermelho de onda de calor acima de 35ºC no PR

en.title: Inmet issues red alert for heat wave exceeding 35°C in Paraná
en.summary: Brazil's meteorological institute issued a red alert for an extreme heat wave affecting Paraná and seven other states beginning Saturday, with temperatures expected to exceed 35 degrees Celsius.

stories.title: Jantar de Lula com empresários lota em São Paulo, e MP das bets repercute bem entre presentes

en.title: Lula's dinner with businesspeople fills venue in São Paulo, and betting MP receives positive reception among attendees
en.summary: President Lula held a dinner with prominent executives and bankers in São Paulo on Friday that drew a large and influential crowd. The event was well-received by business leaders attending, and discussions included a measure on betting regulations.

stories.title: A empresários, Lula defende responsabilidade fiscal, estabilidade e soberania

en.title: To businesspeople, Lula defends fiscal responsibility, stability and sovereignty
en.summary: President Lula addressed over 740 business leaders and economists nine days before elections, emphasizing fiscal responsibility, stability and national sovereignty. He highlighted his political experience in unifying the country and defending democracy while criticizing foreign interference.

stories.title: Alckmin diz que Lula é o único capaz de unir os Poderes e afirma que há espaço para cortar despesas

en.title: Alckmin says Lula is the only one capable of uniting the Powers and affirms there is room to cut spending
en.summary: Vice President Alckmin told hundreds of business executives that President Lula is uniquely positioned to unite the branches of government and reconcile the country. Alckmin also stated that the federal government has opportunities to reduce expenditures.

stories.title: Como funciona o Desenrola Brasil 3.0? Entenda

en.title: How does Desenrola Brasil 3.0 work? Understand
en.summary: The federal government issued a provisional measure Friday establishing Desenrola Brasil 3.0, a program allowing the government to purchase portfolios of overdue debts from individuals and renegotiate them. The program targets debts between two and four and a half years overdue.

stories.title: Vamos tratar como legado de Lula a diminuição dos juros, que tem que ser estrutural, diz Durigan

en.title: We will treat interest rate reduction as Lula's legacy, which must be structural, says Durigan
en.summary: Finance Minister Dario Durigan emphasized President Lula's commitment to fiscal responsibility and lowering interest rates, stating that structural reduction in rates would be a key legacy if Lula is reelected.
